---
title: "Milestone5Tasks_Sidney"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
bestseller <- read_csv("../../data/clean/full_bestseller.csv")
```

```{r}
clean <- bestseller %>% 
  group_by(title) %>%
  summarize(
    best_ranking = min(rank),
    max_weeks_on_list = max(weeks_on_list),
    publisher = first(publisher),
    author = first(author),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
clean %>% 
  filter(max_weeks_on_list > 1) %>% 
  filter(best_ranking == 1) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = max_weeks_on_list)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10)
```

```{r}
clean %>% 
  #filter(title == "LESSONS IN CHEMISTRY") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = best_ranking, y = max_weeks_on_list)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth()

```
